draft.emotion: a dry, parched feeling that makes you want to find water immediately
notes: In formal Arabic, the feminine is عَطْشَى (ʿaṭšā) and the plural is عِطَاش (ʿiṭāš), though عَطْشَانَة (ʿaṭšāna) is very common in everyday speech.
As a diptote, عَطْشَان does not take nunation (tanwīn).
